subject: Postcall exec recap - Helix Pharma procurement path & risks
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@helixpharma.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Postcall exec recap - Helix Pharma procurement path & risks

Hi Samantha
Great to meet you and the Helix team earlier. Quick exec-facing recap so we have alignment on outcomes, risks, and next steps. I’ve kept this focused for your leadership/ procurement folks.

Key business goals we heard
- Reduce average time-to-answer for clinical support queries from ~18 hours to <1 hour (primary business KPI).
- Offload routine triage to an automated assistant to free up 2 FTEs in Q3.
- Improve search & summarization for research teams to accelerate trials.

Primary pain points
- Latency and cost spike when running weekend batch workloads against current vendor.
- Lack of clear data isolation options for PHI-adjacent workflows; current workflows require manual audit steps.
- Procurement wants a clear SLA/penalty and evidence of SOC2 + encryption-at-rest + KMS integration.

Technical fit / Redwood capabilities relevant to Helix
- Dedicated VPC deployment with customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) and audit logs.
- Deployment options: Hosted API for quick pilot vs Private (on-prem/VPC) for production PHI workflows.
- Cost controls: batching, KV caching, and quantization profiles to reduce token cost while meeting latency SLOs.

Risks the execs should be aware of
- Timeline risk: Private deployment and KMS integration typically take 6–8 weeks after PO.
- Security evidence: we can provide SOC2 Type II and architecture docs, but on-prem tooling requires SSO/KMS work from Helix infra team.
- Escalation path: we offer SLA-backed Dedicated contracts; exceptions need VP approval.

Procurement path and timing (as discussed)
- Helix procurement to share timeline & PO target date (Samantha indicated end of March is preferred).
- We will provide a redlines-friendly SOW + standard DPA; procurement to review and return within 10 business days.

Agreed next steps
1) Aditya/Marissa: Share SOC2 package + security questionnaire responses by EOD Monday (attached). [attachment: Helix_Security_Questionnaire.pdf]
2) Samantha: Share procurement timeline + preferred PO contact (procurement@helixpharma.com)
3) Schedule a 30-min exec sponsor call (Laura + Helix VP of R&D) to cover business outcomes & decision criteria — proposed windows below.
4) Marissa: Draft a preliminary cost/throughput estimate for a Dedicated pilot based on 100k monthly tokens; deliver by Wed.

Proposed exec windows (Pacific)
- Tue 2/16 09:00–09:30 or 11:00–11:30
- Wed 2/17 15:00–15:30

Thanks again — I’ll follow up with the SOC2 pack and the security questionnaire filled out.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference

Thanks Aditya — concise and super helpful.

A few quick asks from our side before the exec call:
- Can we add a single slide that maps Helix's three business goals to measurable success metrics and the milestone plan? I’ll present this at the sponsor call.
- Please include a short note on fallback behavior and graceful degradation (we should be explicit for risk conversations).

I can host the exec sponsor call on Tue 2/16 at 09:00 PT. Samantha — does that work for your VP of R&D? If not, propose an alternate and we’ll adapt.

Laura Bennett

I’ll be on the exec call Tue at 09:00 PT.
